body:
I'm running a version somewhere between 2.2b1 and 2.2b2 on a 5.4.11 with APC 3.1.14 in production and I'm not experiencing any problems.
The same app is also running fine on my dev machine which has the same php version and an xdebig installed, but no APC.. Have you tried to disable some php extensions yet?

We are running PHP 5.4.11 too but with XCache instead of APC. Disabling XCache however doesn't make any difference.

Symfony 2.1.7 introduced some changes in PhpDumper which is probably the cause of those errors, but I'm not sure yet what it is.
https://github.com/symfony/symfony/compare/v2.1.6...v2.1.7
